## Summary

Describe the problem and the change. Link a related issue if one exists.

## Verification

List the commands run and their results. Distinguish local checks from hosted CI and browser previews from native execution. For visible changes, include a screenshot with synthetic data.

## Boundaries

- [ ] No credentials, private records, or unapproved source actions are included.
- [ ] Changed behavior and documentation agree.
- [ ] Applicable tests and lint passed, or an exact blocker is described above.
- [ ] User-facing changes are noted under Unreleased in CHANGELOG.md, or this is not applicable.

State any unresolved licensing, security, or native-integration prerequisites. Do not claim a release or live integration based only on preview tests.
